wave.summary: Added a local `ageLabel(iso, nowIso)` helper in src/components/AttentionQueue.tsx that returns the Gazetteer's no-commit marker '—' when the activity instant parses at or before 2000-01-01 (which covers Date.parse === 0, the server's '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z' comparator floor), and otherwise delegates to the existing `relativeAge`. Only the age-slot render site changed. `relativeAge` itself is deliberately untouched because the Gazetteer imports it and already renders '—' for repos with no last-commit iso — narrowing the shared function would have been out of scope and could shift Fig. 5 behavior. Server code, the comparator, and all other row markup are unchanged. TDD: wrote the failing test first in src/views/Overview.test.tsx (it printed '20666d' against the fixture's generatedAt), then made it pass; the test mounts Overview with an extra attention entry for `meridian` carrying the epoch fallback and asserts the age slot is exactly '—', does not match /\d+d/, that the reason badge and name still render, and that a real row (ember-ledger) still ages to '1d'. No existing assertions were modified. node_modules was symlinked from the main repo (untracked, not committed). `npx tsc --noEmit` is unavailable — typescript is not an installed dependency and I did not install it.

Verified every claim against the actual code before writing: shared/contract.js (attention priority order, isStale/STALE_DAYS=90 strict inequality, dayKey local-TZ bucketing, upstream three-state contract, CSS render vocabulary), server/index.js (createServer, cache-first /api/atlas, single-flight rescan, SSE scan-events, DEFAULT_PORT=4600), server/scan.js and server/loc.js (discoverRepos walk-time pruning of node_modules/dist/build/.git/vendor/.next/target/coverage, per-file and per-repo caps, extension->language table), server/gitFacts.js (execFile argv-array git plumbing, never-throws design, ahead/behind parse order), server/attention.js (dirty>unpushed>stale priority, no-remote never unpushed, zero-commit epoch fallback), src/App.tsx (hash routing, cross-filter day state, masthead/theme toggle), src/views/Overview.tsx (Fig.1-5 plate order and captions), src/views/RepoDetail.tsx (Fig.6-10 drill-down), src/hooks/useKeyboardNav.ts (j/k/Enter, ignores editable targets), src/hooks/useTheme.ts (data-theme attribute + localStorage + system-preference fallback), src/components/CommandPalette.tsx (Cmd+K wiring), package.json scripts (start = vite build && node server/index.js, test = vitest run), vite.config.ts (TZ pinned to America/Chicago), and .gitignore (.atlas-cache.json is the on-disk cache, confirming no DB claim). Covers: what Repo Atlas is, npm start/test, first-scan timing (~60-90s), the plain-Node+frozen-contract+Vite/React architecture, every implemented feature (attention queue, heatmap+timeline cross-filter, Gazetteer search/sort, drill-down Fig.6-10, Cmd+K palette, j/k nav, themes, live rescan via SSE), and the read-only/local-git-only/no-DB/no-auth boundaries. No test location was in my file scope (README.md only), so no new test file was created — instead I ran the full existing suite via a temporary node_modules symlink to the main repo (removed after) to confirm the codebase I documented is actually green.
